data.title: NVIDIA releases DGX Spark firmware 2.3 with dual-node 200 GbE support
data.description: The 2.3 firmware turns the ConnectX-7 port into a supported two-node fabric, and NVIDIA publishes a playbook for splitting a 400B model across two Sparks.
data.markdown:
# NVIDIA releases DGX Spark firmware 2.3

NVIDIA's 2.3 firmware for the DGX Spark enables the ConnectX-7 port as a supported two-node fabric at 200 GbE. The accompanying playbook shows DeepSeek V4 Flash split across two units with exo and with vLLM's pipeline parallelism. Update through the DGX Dashboard; the update takes about 12 minutes and requires a reboot.

data.title: Apple M5 Max Mac Studio benchmarks leak: 1.1 TB/s memory bandwidth
data.description: Leaked Geekbench and llama.cpp numbers put the M5 Max ahead of the DGX Spark on single-stream decode.
data.markdown:
# M5 Max Mac Studio benchmarks leak

A Geekbench listing and a llama.cpp run show the M5 Max at 1.1 TB/s memory bandwidth, about 4x the DGX Spark's 273 GB/s, which lifts single-stream decode on 70B Q4 to roughly 28 tok/s.

data.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash arrives with open weights and a 128K context
data.description: The 160B mixture-of-experts model activates 12B parameters per token and ships under an MIT license.
data.markdown:
# DeepSeek V4 Flash arrives

DeepSeek released V4 Flash on Monday with open weights on Hugging Face. The model activates 12B of 160B parameters per token and fits on a 128 GB box at 4-bit. Day-0 support landed in vLLM 0.12 and SGLang 0.6.

data.title: Micron HBM shortage pushes consumer GPU prices up 15 percent
data.description: RTX 5090 street prices climbed again this week as memory supply tightens.
data.markdown:
# HBM shortage pushes GPU prices up

Retail RTX 5090 prices rose about 15 percent over the past month as HBM and GDDR7 supply tightened. Used RTX 3090 prices are flat.

data.title: Mistral Medium 4 goes Apache 2.0, targets on-prem enterprise deployments
data.description: Mistral's mid-size model is now fully open, with a pitch aimed at regulated industries that cannot send data to the cloud.
data.markdown:
# Mistral Medium 4 goes Apache 2.0

Mistral released Medium 4 under Apache 2.0 with a pitch at hospitals, law firms and banks that need on-premises inference. The 48B dense model runs at 4-bit on a single 48 GB GPU.

data.title: EU AI Act GPAI obligations start biting: what small firms must log
data.description: From this month, small firms using general-purpose AI in regulated workflows must keep usage logs, a task on-premises deployments make simpler.
data.markdown:
# EU AI Act GPAI obligations

The Commission's guidance clarifies that firms deploying general-purpose AI in regulated workflows must keep prompt and output logs for audits. Running the model on premises keeps the logs inside the firm.
